text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
The Umamusume are entering their second lap!
(Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Whoa... Seriously, two laps?! Yikes. That's way too long...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Legs are so heavy. Hard to breathe...
Why am I... runnin' so hard...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Wait, Gold Ship, is she okay back there?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Ahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna win so baaaad!
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haha... What a crazy look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just ran, okay...? And my face is sweating like crazy. Can't be helped...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm not talkin' about visuals here.
How do I put it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Stay an idiot just like that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... of course, right?
And on top of that, I'll surpass you—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that guy?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......Right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... damn you, Golshi...!
What was that about...? Telling me to stay stupid...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're way dumber than they are...

After returning to the waiting room, Tosen Jordan
collapsed completely limp onto the sofa.
A 3200m long-distance turf race. Having given their all in this arena where stayers clash, it's only natural that they'd be exhausted.

In order to surpass that single person
I used as an example—my goal.
Even on a stage like the Tenno Sho (Spring), driven solely by those feelings, she can run straight ahead without wavering.

For the sake of a single goal, she'll grit her teeth and push forward no matter what.
She's overflowing with fighting spirit—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Finally got the feeling back in my legs.
I'm so exhausted...
choice_data_list: You really do have incredible talent.
You really do have incredible talent.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha... right?
After all, I'm aimin' to be the strongest idiot out there!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, the Takarazuka Kinen is good for our next race, right?
Golshi said to go for that one, too.
choice_data_list: Want to go challenge them again?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that fine then?
I mean, she's way more of an idiot than me, right?

...However, if she will continue to face opponents who can sharpen her weapons,
there is no reason not to make use of it.

"Then let us head forth.
To the final stage of the Spring Senior Triple Crown—the Takarazuka Kinen."
